title: Fabric is to thin.
text: Fabric is to thin.. The fabric is very thin. My pillow has a logo on it and you can see it through the fabric. The ruffles lay flat and flop over probably because of how thin the fabric is. Bit disappointed. They were a flop. Haha see what I did there?
